text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends to refuse the installation of an All-Way Stop Control at the intersection of Lowcrest Boulevard and Vradenberg Drive as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has a stop control facing the eastbound on Vradenberg Drive approach of this T-type intersection.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Lowcrest Boulevard and Vradenberg Drive.
